note: The head-type roots a NAMED COMPOUND ('Nobel Prize', 'Fields Medal', 'Curie Institute', 'Boyle's Law', 'Pythagoras Theorem') composes to. NOT a name table and NOT a head-word table: each root is a WordNet ROOT SYNSET, and a head word is a member iff its noun senses descend from the root (award.n.02 covers prize/medal/award/trophy; organization.n.01/institution.n.01 cover university/institute/committee/academy/foundation/society; proposition.n.01 covers theorem; law.n.01 covers law). Extensible: drop another HeadTypeRoot node to admit a new head family. `animate 0` = the composed entity is an inanimate honour/institution/proposition. The acquisition-verb roots (AcquireVerbRoot) type the WIN/RECEIVE/EARN class the coherence-check uses for the role-mismatch signal (a person as the THEME of 'won' is incoherent) — again a WordNet root, not a verb list.
